Q: Conditional formatting with custom formula skipping an empty cell A:

the B3 is not locked with $ so B3<>"" is evaluated in every column of B:G. either lock it:


=AND($B3<>"", $E3=INDIRECT("Mike Jones"))

or use OR logic if thats what you want:

=OR(B3<>"", $E3=INDIRECT("Mike Jones"))

Q: access ElementTree node parent node A:

You can build a dictionary with all the elements parents for the document:

parent_map = {child: parent for parent in root.iter() for child in parent}

And then look up the parents on the fly:

parent=parent_map[child]

Q: How can Mixins be used to inject into a lambda statement A:

You were very close, just fix the descriptors.

Correct version:

@Mixin(Foo.class)
public abstract class FooMixin {
    @Inject(
        method = "lambda$bar$0()V",
        at = @At(
            value = "INVOKE",
            target = "Ljava/io/PrintStream;println(Ljava/lang/String;)V",
            shift = At.Shift.AFTER,
            remap = false
        )
    )
    private static void doSomething(CallbackInfo ci) {
        System.out.println("The mixin has succeeded");
    }
}

Key fixes:

  1. method = "lambda$bar$0()V" (not "(;)V")

  2. target must include return type -> ...;)V

  3. Add remap = false for JDK methods

  4. Make injector static (lambda is static)

That’s it.

Q: What is changing the page orientation for Mobile version on my first Web Page A:

both files manipulate with max-width and orientation CSS params. in main.css file you can find e.g. @media screen and (max-width: 736px) or @media screen and (orientation: portrait) - styles for some dimensions (screens not larger that 736px), and one of these kind-of-ifs are making this vertical layout conversion
